slides.text: 5 things on your blood test that can be “in range” and still be the reason you feel awful
slides.sub: nobody read these back to you
Iron storage. Can be near the floor while hemoglobin looks fine.
The active thyroid hormone. TSH alone can look perfect.
Low across most of the northern hemisphere, most of the year.
Background inflammation. Cheap, and almost never ordered.
Moves years before fasting glucose does. Not on a standard panel.

slides.text: Upload the PDF and have it read back to you.
